comment: The pipeline machinery is duplicated across ryanphillipthomas/focx and ryanphillipthomas/studio-810 by hand. This manifest is the record of which files are supposed to stay in lockstep, so that divergence is a failing check instead of a discovery months later. Identical copies of this file must exist in both repos.

local.comment: Deliberately repo-specific — each repo describes its own apps, packages, and design-system layering. Listed so the manifest is a complete account of the shared surface rather than a partial one. Not checked. tools/drift-check is here because the two implementations genuinely diverged: studio-810 generalized the parent/child token model that focx still hardcodes as focx/connect. That is a real difference worth reconciling one day, not a copy that slipped.
